scope: Saved-view client contract and UI with every API fulfilled locally. CRUD writes modify only this script memory.

contracts.reads: Directory is on demand; scoped pagination is not a full-result claim.
contracts.save: Only committed query and applied table state; fixed editor snapshots, stable create ID, CAS revisions and no automatic write retries.
contracts.load: A confirmed resource snapshot is copied into literal URL/table state, not dynamically bound by saved-view ID.
contracts.unknown: GET reads current resource state, not an exact receipt for the original mutation. No durable unknown-operation journal is claimed.
contracts.browser: Chrome desktop/mobile viewports, synthetic composition and local fixtures are not real-provider, physical-device, Safari or final visual acceptance.
